name: Triple Momentum (3/6/12-month multi-timeframe)
description: Combine 3-, 6-, and 12-month price momentum; go long when enough of the lookbacks agree. Pitched as durable because it's grounded in an 'economic principle' (momentum) rather than a fast-decaying mathematical mispricing.

setup.description: votes = count of {3mo, 6mo, 12mo} returns that are positive; long when votes >= min_agree (default 2 of 3).

verdict.claim: based on economic principles -> robust, slow to decay, ran 4 years
verdict.conceptual_take: FAIR and actually a good insight — his point that economic-principle strategies (momentum, value) decay slower than pure-math arbitrage is sound. Momentum is one of the most durable documented anomalies.
verdict.robustness_test: Walk-forward SPY: 'params reasonably stable', low param churn (4/13 windows) — genuinely NOT overfit. His durability claim holds.
verdict.performance_test: But it does NOT beat plain single-lookback momentum: SPY excess-Sharpe 0.70 vs 0.88, QQQ 0.84 vs 0.96; OOS 80% vs 140%; deeper drawdowns. Diversifying across 3/6/12mo dilutes the signal more than it cuts noise on liquid indices.
verdict.honest_take: Legit, robust, non-overfit strategy — added to the catalog — but currently loses to the momentum champion. Third genuine strategy of the reel batch; a good idea that just isn't the best available.
